spec.description: Adoption and capacity across the selected tenant datasources, one repeated section per tenant. Controller-reported Nais Postgres resources versus Config Connector Cloud SQL instances (all engines; engine labels unavailable). Unknown is not zero. Capacity covers discovered Nais Postgres DB pods, branches and replicas, not Cloud SQL or total service cost. Historical coverage depends on metric availability; no retrospective inventory is reconstructed.

panels.description: Nais Postgres: distinct logical postgres.nais.io resources reported by pgrator, not branches/pods. Cloud SQL: Config Connector SQLInstance resources, all engines and statuses, not SQL databases or HA nodes. Teams are namespaces within each environment; the same team in dev/prod appears in both rows. Unknown includes absent/empty inventories or failed sources; even a successful scrape cannot prove an empty inventory means zero. Config Connector resets/rebuilds its gauge periodically, so transient Unknown/partial counts can occur. These are reported observations, not an authoritative migration ledger.

Counts include non-ready resources reported by the controllers. Gaps are unknown; last legend value is only the latest observation in the selected range. Changes are net inventory changes, not proof of migration or counts of creates/deletes.

panels.description: Nais Postgres database containers/data volumes only, across all discovered branches and replicas. Excludes poolers, operators, backup storage, network and logging. Missing Kubernetes/discovery data is not zero. Not Cloud SQL capacity or a billing estimate. CPU requested is Kubernetes container requests, not allocated node vCPU or a guarantee of CPU availability.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name) ((max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{container="postgres", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", resource="cpu"})) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (up{job="nais-system/cloudnative-pg-postgres", postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}))

sum by (k8s_cluster_name) ((max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="postgres", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (up{job="nais-system/cloudnative-pg-postgres", postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}))
